items.name: AVRO_DOC_METADATA_KEY
items.summary: Metadata key used to store the documentation for a type in an Avro schema.

items.name: AVRO_ENUM_SYMBOLS_METADATA_KEY
items.summary: Metadata key used to represent Avro enum symbols in an Arrow schema.

items.name: AVRO_FIELD_DEFAULT_METADATA_KEY
items.summary: Metadata key used to store the default value of a field in an Avro schema.

items.name: AVRO_NAMESPACE_METADATA_KEY
items.summary: Metadata key used to store the name of a type in an Avro schema.

items.name: AVRO_NAME_METADATA_KEY
items.summary: Metadata key used to store the name of a type in an Avro schema.

items.name: AVRO_ROOT_RECORD_DEFAULT_NAME
items.summary: Default name for the root record in an Avro schema.

items.name: MAX_PREFIX_LEN
items.summary: The maximum possible length of a prefix. SHA256 (32) + single-object magic (2)

items.name: SCHEMA_METADATA_KEY
items.summary: The metadata key used for storing the JSON encoded `Schema`

items.name: Fingerprint
items.summary: A schema fingerprint in one of the supported formats.

methods.name: load_fingerprint_id
methods.summary: Loads the 32-bit Schema Registry fingerprint (Confluent Schema Registry ID).

methods.name: load_fingerprint_id64
methods.summary: Loads the 64-bit Schema Registry fingerprint (Apicurio Schema Registry ID).

items.name: FingerprintAlgorithm
items.summary: Supported fingerprint algorithms for Avro schema identification. For use with Confluent Schema Registry IDs, set to None.

items.name: FingerprintStrategy
items.summary: Defines the strategy for generating the per-record prefix for an Avro binary stream.

items.name: AvroSchema
items.summary: A wrapper for an Avro schema in its JSON string representation.

methods.name: fingerprint
methods.signature: fn fingerprint(&self, hash_type: FingerprintAlgorithm) -> Result<Fingerprint, ArrowError>
methods.summary: Returns the fingerprint of the schema, computed using the specified [`FingerprintAlgorithm`].

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Creates a new `AvroSchema` from a JSON string.

methods.name: try_from
methods.summary: Converts an `ArrowSchema` to `AvroSchema`, delegating to `AvroSchema::from_arrow_with_options` with `None` so that the union null ordering is decided by `Nullability::default()`.

items.name: SchemaStore
items.summary: An in-memory cache of Avro schemas, indexed by their fingerprint.

methods.name: fingerprints
methods.summary: Returns a `Vec` containing **all unique [`Fingerprint`]s** currently held by this [`SchemaStore`].

methods.name: lookup
methods.summary: Looks up a schema by its `Fingerprint`.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Creates an empty `SchemaStore` using the default fingerprinting algorithm (64-bit Rabin).

methods.name: new_with_type
methods.summary: Creates an empty `SchemaStore` using the default fingerprinting algorithm (64-bit Rabin).

methods.name: register
methods.signature: fn register(&mut self, schema: AvroSchema) -> Result<Fingerprint, ArrowError>
methods.summary: Registers a schema with the store and returns its fingerprint.

methods.name: set
methods.signature: fn set(&mut self, fingerprint: Fingerprint, schema: AvroSchema) -> Result<Fingerprint, ArrowError>
methods.summary: Registers a schema with the store and the provided fingerprint. Note: Confluent wire format implementations should leverage this method.

methods.name: try_from
methods.signature: fn try_from(schemas: HashMap<Fingerprint, AvroSchema>) -> Result<Self, Self::Error>
methods.summary: Creates a `SchemaStore` from a HashMap of schemas. Each schema in the HashMap is registered with the new store.
